summary: Mercedes' straight-line advantage intensifies the title fight at Monza as Hamilton and his team seek to extend their lead over a Ferrari outfit still playing catch-up with their new engine upgrade. Red Bull faces a tactical reshuffling with Hadjar sidelined by wrist injury, potentially opening opportunities for rivals in the midfield battle. Extreme heat conditions declared across the circuit will test tire management and fuel consumption strategies, making fuel efficiency and pit-stop precision decisive factors in a championship race where every point matters.
